payers.Carelon (PBHS): Maryland Public Behavioral Health System, administered by Carelon

rules.reason: Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) requires prior authorization across payers.
notes: Expect failed-medication-trial documentation and diagnosis criteria in the DTR questionnaire.

rules.reason: Psychological / neuropsychological testing typically requires prior authorization.
rules.source: Payer BH testing policy / Carelon Master Service Authorization Grid
notes: Document referral question, tests planned, and estimated units/hours.

rules.reason: IOP / PHP / structured outpatient programs require prior authorization.
Outpatient behavioral-health services are authorized per the Carelon Master Service Authorization Grid — an initial span may be authorized, with continued care requiring an updated authorization.
rules.source: BHW P&P Manual P-2 (Service Authorization / Carelon-PBHS)
notes: Match the authorization span, code, and modifier on the claim (P-2).
Track expirations at 30/14/7 days (P-2 authorization tracker).

rules.reason: Chronic care / remote monitoring / behavioral-health integration management (CCM/PCM/RPM/CoCM) does not require prior authorization.
notes: Consent + time documentation still required (see documentation checklist).

rules.reason: Standard office/outpatient E/M visits do not require prior authorization.
